sentence_stem: Although the newspaper article seemed objective,
correct_completion: its headline clearly favoured one political party.
full_sentence: Although the newspaper article seemed objective, its headline clearly favoured one political party.
acceptable_variants: its tone was nonetheless strongly biased in favour of one side.
its headline nonetheless leaned toward one party.

options.text: the reporter gathered all the facts from several sources.
options.why_wrong: This continues the idea of objectivity instead of contrasting with it, so 'although' has no contrast to mark.

options.text: its headline clearly favoured one political party.
readers therefore trusted every word of it.
options.why_wrong: 'Therefore' expresses a result, not a contrast, so it does not fit the concessive structure started by 'although'.

options.text: the article was printed on the front page.
options.why_wrong: This adds a neutral fact that does not contrast with the apparent objectivity of the article.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' in academic reporting
explanation: After 'although', the sentence needs a clause that contrasts with the first part, which says the article seemed objective. The correct option reveals bias, while the other options continue the idea of objectivity or add a result or neutral fact. Speakers of languages with a similar concessive structure may still add a second contrast word, which is incorrect in English.
translation: Haber yazısı tarafsız görünmesine rağmen, başlığı açıkça bir siyasi partiyi destekliyordu.
